observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera body with a lens cap on the front and a lens cap on the rear.
The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 600D' printed on the top.
The lens is an EF-S 18-55mm lens.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with the LCD screen and control buttons.
Photo 2 shows the same camera and lens as Photo 0, but also includes a second Canon camera (EOS 700D) and a different lens (28-90mm).
The camera body and lens appear to be in good cosmetic condition.
The photos contain a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI KJ-TECH.'
The camera body is missing the battery and charger.

No photo shows this; it requires a shutter count tool or a photo of the camera in a service center.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
